plans.name: 30-Day High-Yield Crash Course
plans.subtitle: Target: 35+ in SBI/IBPS Clerk Mains in 4 Weeks
plans.target_audience: Candidates with Mains exam within 3-4 weeks or students looking for high-efficiency revision.

phases.focus: RBI Structure & History, Monetary Policy Tools, Policy Rates (Repo/SDF/MSF/Bank Rate), CRR & SLR, MPC Framework, PMJDY, PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY, MUDRA Scheme.
daily_checklist: Study RBI establishment, acts, and subsidiaries
Simulate rate transmission on RBI Policy Visualizer
Master all numerical values for PMJDY, PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY, and MUDRA
Solve 40 Practice Arena questions on RBI & Policy Rates

phases.focus: Payment Systems (UPI, UPI Lite, UPI 123Pay, RTGS, NEFT, IMPS, CBDC), NPCI ecosystem, NPA Lifecycle, SMA-0/1/2, SARFAESI Act, IBC 2016, DICGC.
daily_checklist: Explore UPI Transaction Flow and NPA Lifecycle Visualizers
Learn DICGC insurance limits and 90-day resolution timeline
Solve 50 Practice Arena questions on Payment Systems and NPAs

phases.focus: Money Market (T-Bills, CP, CD, CMB, Call/Notice/Term Money), Capital Market basics, Basel III capital pyramid, Banking Dictionary 40+ terms, Confusion Buster.
daily_checklist: Master T-Bills tenors, CP minimums, and CD maturities
Revise Confusion Buster pairs (Nostro vs Vostro, Repo vs SDF, MCLR vs EBLR)
Take 1 Full Mock Exam (SBI/IBPS Clerk pattern)

phases.focus: Last 6 months Banking Current Affairs, RBI Circulars, Question Selection Strategy Trainer, Revision of 'My Mistakes' notebook, 3 Full-length timed mocks.
daily_checklist: Review Daily Capsules and Monthly Current Affairs repository
Practice First 5-Minute Question Selection Strategy Trainer
Review all bookmarked questions and error notebook
Take 2 Full Mock Tests with strict 35-minute timer
